description: This file implements a hardware interrupt request (IRQ) controller model for the Zephyr POSIX environment, managing IRQ states, priorities, enabling/disabling, and handling immediate or deferred IRQ raising.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_init
methods.description: Initializes the IRQ controller, setting all IRQs to disabled and default priorities.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup; currently does nothing.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_set_cur_prio
methods.description: Sets the currently running interrupt priority.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_get_cur_prio
methods.description: Returns the priority of the currently running interrupt.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_prio_set
methods.description: Sets the priority for a specific IRQ.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_get_prio
methods.description: Gets the priority of a specific IRQ.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_get_highest_prio_irq
methods.description: Returns the highest priority pending IRQ that is higher than the current running priority.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_get_current_lock
methods.description: Returns whether IRQs are locked.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_change_lock
methods.description: Changes the IRQ lock state and triggers pending IRQ handling if unlocking.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_get_irq_status
methods.description: Returns the current IRQ status bits.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_clear_all_enabled_irqs
methods.description: Clears all enabled IRQs.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_clear_all_irqs
methods.description: Clears all IRQs and masks.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_disable_irq
methods.description: Disables a specific IRQ.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_is_irq_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ is enabled.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_get_irq_mask
methods.description: Returns the current IRQ mask.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_clear_irq
methods.description: Clears a specific IRQ.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_enable_irq
methods.description: Enables a specific IRQ and raises it if pending.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_set_irq
methods.description: Sets or raises an IRQ, scheduling immediate or deferred handling.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_raise_im
methods.description: Raises an IRQ immediately, waking the CPU.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_raise_im_from_sw
methods.description: Raises an IRQ immediately from software context.

methods.name: hw_irq_ctrl_timer_triggered
methods.description: Handles timer trigger event, raising IRQs as needed.
